title: Pat-a-Cake Baker's Man
lyrics: Pat-a-cake, pat-a-cake, baker's man, bake me a cake as fast as you can! Pat it and prick it and mark it with B, and put it in the oven for baby and me!
speech: Let's sing together: Pat-a-Cake Baker's Man! Pat-a-cake, pat-a-cake, baker's man, bake me a cake as fast as you can! Pat it and prick it and mark it with B, and put it in the oven for baby and me!

title: Rain Rain Go Away
lyrics: Rain, rain, go away, come again another day! Little Johnny wants to play, rain, rain, go away!
speech: Let's sing together: Rain Rain Go Away! Rain, rain, go away, come again another day! Little Johnny wants to play, rain, rain, go away!

title: One Two Buckle My Shoe
lyrics: One, two, buckle my shoe; three, four, knock at the door; five, six, pick up sticks; seven, eight, lay them straight; nine, ten, a big fat hen!
speech: Let's sing together: One Two Buckle My Shoe! One, two, buckle my shoe; three, four, knock at the door; five, six, pick up sticks; seven, eight, lay them straight; nine, ten, a big fat hen!

title: If You Are Happy and You Know It
lyrics: If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands! If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands! If you're happy and you know it, then your face will surely show it!
speech: Let's sing together: If You Are Happy and You Know It! If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands! If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands! If you're happy and you know it, then your face will surely show it!

title: Head Shoulders Knees and Toes
lyrics: Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes! And eyes and ears and mouth and nose! Head, shoulders, knees and toes!
speech: Let's sing together: Head Shoulders Knees and Toes! Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes! And eyes and ears and mouth and nose! Head, shoulders, knees and toes!

title: The Itsy Bitsy Spider
lyrics: The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout! Down came the rain and washed the spider out!
speech: Let's sing together: The Itsy Bitsy Spider! The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout! Down came the rain and washed the spider out!

title: Hush Little Baby
lyrics: Hush, little baby, don't say a word, Papa's gonna buy you a mockingbird! And if that mockingbird won't sing, Papa's gonna buy you a diamond ring!
speech: Let's sing together: Hush Little Baby! Hush, little baby, don't say a word, Papa's gonna buy you a mockingbird! And if that mockingbird won't sing, Papa's gonna buy you a diamond ring!

title: Jack Be Nimble
lyrics: Jack be nimble, Jack be quick, Jack jump over the candlestick! Jack jumped high, Jack jumped low, Jack didn't burn his little toe!
speech: Let's sing together: Jack Be Nimble! Jack be nimble, Jack be quick, Jack jump over the candlestick! Jack jumped high, Jack jumped low, Jack didn't burn his little toe!

title: Georgie Porgie
lyrics: Georgie Porgie, pudding and pie, kissed the girls and made them cry! When the boys came out to play, Georgie Porgie ran away!
speech: Let's sing together: Georgie Porgie! Georgie Porgie, pudding and pie, kissed the girls and made them cry! When the boys came out to play, Georgie Porgie ran away!

title: Simple Simon
lyrics: Simple Simon met a pieman, going to the fair! Said Simple Simon to the pieman: Let me taste your ware!
speech: Let's sing together: Simple Simon! Simple Simon met a pieman, going to the fair! Said Simple Simon to the pieman: Let me taste your ware!

title: Tom Tom the Piper's Son
lyrics: Tom, Tom, the piper's son, stole a pig and away did run! The pig was eat, and Tom was beat, and Tom went crying down the street!
speech: Let's sing together: Tom Tom the Piper's Son! Tom, Tom, the piper's son, stole a pig and away did run! The pig was eat, and Tom was beat, and Tom went crying down the street!

title: Rub-a-Dub-Dub
lyrics: Rub-a-dub-dub, three men in a tub, and who do you think they be? The butcher, the baker, the candlestick-maker, they all jumped out of a rotten potato!
speech: Let's sing together: Rub-a-Dub-Dub! Rub-a-dub-dub, three men in a tub, and who do you think they be? The butcher, the baker, the candlestick-maker, they all jumped out of a rotten potato!

title: Cobbler Cobbler Mend My Shoe
lyrics: Cobbler, cobbler, mend my shoe, get it done by half past two! Stitch it up and stitch it down, then I'll give you half a crown!
speech: Let's sing together: Cobbler Cobbler Mend My Shoe! Cobbler, cobbler, mend my shoe, get it done by half past two! Stitch it up and stitch it down, then I'll give you half a crown!

title: Little Boy Blue
lyrics: Little Boy Blue, come blow your horn, the sheep's in the meadow, the cow's in the corn! Where is the boy who looks after the sheep? He's under a haystack fast asleep!
speech: Let's sing together: Little Boy Blue! Little Boy Blue, come blow your horn, the sheep's in the meadow, the cow's in the corn! Where is the boy who looks after the sheep? He's under a haystack fast asleep!

title: Cock-a-Doodle-Doo
lyrics: Cock-a-doodle-doo! My dame has lost her shoe! My master's lost his fiddling stick, and knows not what to do!
speech: Let's sing together: Cock-a-Doodle-Doo! Cock-a-doodle-doo! My dame has lost her shoe! My master's lost his fiddling stick, and knows not what to do!

title: Pussycat Pussycat
lyrics: Pussycat, pussycat, where have you been? I've been to London to visit the Queen! Pussycat, pussycat, what did you there? I frightened a little mouse under her chair!
speech: Let's sing together: Pussycat Pussycat! Pussycat, pussycat, where have you been? I've been to London to visit the Queen! Pussycat, pussycat, what did you there? I frightened a little mouse under her chair!

title: Wee Willie Winkie
lyrics: Wee Willie Winkie runs through the town, upstairs and downstairs in his nightgown, tapping at the window, crying through the lock: Are the children in their beds, for now it's eight o'clock?
speech: Let's sing together: Wee Willie Winkie! Wee Willie Winkie runs through the town, upstairs and downstairs in his nightgown, tapping at the window, crying through the lock: Are the children in their beds, for now it's eight o'clock?

title: Doctor Foster
lyrics: Doctor Foster went to Gloucester in a shower of rain! He stepped in a puddle, right up to his middle, and never went there again!
speech: Let's sing together: Doctor Foster! Doctor Foster went to Gloucester in a shower of rain! He stepped in a puddle, right up to his middle, and never went there again!

title: There Was an Old Woman
lyrics: There was an old woman who lived in a shoe, she had so many children she didn't know what to do! She gave them some broth without any bread, and kissed them all soundly and put them to bed!
speech: Let's sing together: There Was an Old Woman! There was an old woman who lived in a shoe, she had so many children she didn't know what to do! She gave them some broth without any bread, and kissed them all soundly and put them to bed!

title: Diddle Diddle Dumpling
lyrics: Diddle, diddle, dumpling, my son John, went to bed with his trousers on! One shoe off, and one shoe on, diddle, diddle, dumpling, my son John!
speech: Let's sing together: Diddle Diddle Dumpling! Diddle, diddle, dumpling, my son John, went to bed with his trousers on! One shoe off, and one shoe on, diddle, diddle, dumpling, my son John!

title: Peter Peter Pumpkin Eater
lyrics: Peter, Peter pumpkin eater, had a wife and couldn't keep her! He put her in a pumpkin shell, and there he kept her very well!
speech: Let's sing together: Peter Peter Pumpkin Eater! Peter, Peter pumpkin eater, had a wife and couldn't keep her! He put her in a pumpkin shell, and there he kept her very well!

title: Old King Cole
lyrics: Old King Cole was a merry old soul, and a merry old soul was he! He called for his pipe, and he called for his bowl, and he called for his fiddlers three!
speech: Let's sing together: Old King Cole! Old King Cole was a merry old soul, and a merry old soul was he! He called for his pipe, and he called for his bowl, and he called for his fiddlers three!

title: Pease Porridge Hot
lyrics: Pease porridge hot, pease porridge cold, pease porridge in the pot, nine days old! Some like it hot, some like it cold, some like it in the pot, nine days old!
speech: Let's sing together: Pease Porridge Hot! Pease porridge hot, pease porridge cold, pease porridge in the pot, nine days old! Some like it hot, some like it cold, some like it in the pot, nine days old!

title: Lucy Locket
lyrics: Lucy Locket lost her pocket, Kitty Fisher found it! Not a penny was there in it, only ribbon round it!
speech: Let's sing together: Lucy Locket! Lucy Locket lost her pocket, Kitty Fisher found it! Not a penny was there in it, only ribbon round it!

title: Two Little Dicky Birds
lyrics: Two little dicky birds sitting on a wall, one named Peter, one named Paul! Fly away Peter! Fly away Paul! Come back Peter! Come back Paul!
speech: Let's sing together: Two Little Dicky Birds! Two little dicky birds sitting on a wall, one named Peter, one named Paul! Fly away Peter! Fly away Paul! Come back Peter! Come back Paul!

title: The Grand Old Duke of York
lyrics: Oh, the grand old Duke of York, he had ten thousand men! He marched them up to the top of the hill, and he marched them down again!
speech: Let's sing together: The Grand Old Duke of York! Oh, the grand old Duke of York, he had ten thousand men! He marched them up to the top of the hill, and he marched them down again!

title: Lavender's Blue
lyrics: Lavender's blue, dilly, dilly, lavender's green! When I am king, dilly, dilly, you shall be queen!
speech: Let's sing together: Lavender's Blue! Lavender's blue, dilly, dilly, lavender's green! When I am king, dilly, dilly, you shall be queen!

title: Rock-a-Bye Baby
lyrics: Rock-a-bye baby, on the tree top! When the wind blows, the cradle will rock! When the bough breaks, the cradle will fall, and down will come baby, cradle and all!
speech: Let's sing together: Rock-a-Bye Baby! Rock-a-bye baby, on the tree top! When the wind blows, the cradle will rock! When the bough breaks, the cradle will fall, and down will come baby, cradle and all!

title: Star Light Star Bright
lyrics: Star light, star bright, first star I see tonight! I wish I may, I wish I might, have the wish I wish tonight!
speech: Let's sing together: Star Light Star Bright! Star light, star bright, first star I see tonight! I wish I may, I wish I might, have the wish I wish tonight!
